newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-S.Africa struggles to 119-7 v India's 223.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-S.Africa struggles to 119-7 v India's 223.

text.p: Tight bowling by India's spin trio saw South Africa collapse to 119 for seven wickets at tea on the second day on Thursday of the first test.
Indian spinners -- Anil Kumble, Sunil Joshi and Narendra Hirwani -- exploited a helpful pitch to set their team up for what could be a match-winning lead in the first innings.

In addition to top spin, the home side were also helped by some doubtful umpiring decisions. South African captain Hansie Cronje and Darryl Cullinan were both given out leg before wicket to deliveries which pitched outside the leg stump.
The umpire in both cases was S.K. Bansal.
Cullinan hit 43, the highest score so far in the South African innings. Joshi has taken three wickets for 24 runs, Hirwani two for 28 and Kumble two for 38.
Earlier India were out for 223 shortly before lunch.
